name: Bom Choi
source:
"Tell me anything, anytime. I'm good at looking after the people I care about."
That's what she said to me. 
She's the one everyone turns to– reliable, capable, always one step ahead. 
A great captain deserves a great first mate. 
And I won't be just a passive passenger on this ship.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/moond/moonlight-dialogue-an-otome-visual-novel-for-mobile/description/]Kickstarter[/url]]
